item.title: Bipolar Disorder Case Study Explores Identity and Patient Experience
item.description: A recently published case study suggests life story narration in bipolar disorder can solidify with time, into a coherent, emotion shaped worldview. The post Bipolar Disorder Case Study Explores Identity and Patient Experience appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: HPV Vaccine May Cut Cervical Cancer Screenings
item.description: Women who have had the HPV vaccine may need fewer cervical cancer screenings, a 2026 Norwegian study has found. The post HPV Vaccine May Cut Cervical Cancer Screenings appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Cancer in the Excluded Stomach After Gastric Bypass
item.description: Nordic data link gastric bypass to rare, excluded stomach cancer, with risk rising after 10 years and diagnosis potentially delayed. The post Cancer in the Excluded Stomach After Gastric Bypass appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Gene Therapy Breakthrough Restores Key Function in Cystic Fibrosis
item.description: UCLA researchers use lipid nanoparticles to insert full CFTR gene into airway cells, restoring function and opening new avenues for CF therapy. The post Gene Therapy Breakthrough Restores Key Function in Cystic Fibrosis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: High Incidence of Postoperative Acute Kidney Injury in Surgical ICUs
item.description: More than half of surgical ICU patients developed postoperative acute kidney injury, with sepsis, trauma, and CKD among key risk factors. The post High Incidence of Postoperative Acute Kidney Injury in Surgical ICUs appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Brain Age as a New Biomarker for Diagnosing Mental Disorders
item.description: This study shows that brain age as a biomarker may help diagnose mental disorders earlier, and guide more personalised psychiatric treatment. The post Brain Age as a New Biomarker for Diagnosing Mental Disorders appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Physical Activity After Diagnosis Linked to Lower Cancer Mortality
item.description: Higher levels of leisure-time physical activity after cancer diagnosis were associated with lower cancer mortality in survivors of several tumour types. The post Physical Activity After Diagnosis Linked to Lower Cancer Mortality appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Colorectal Cancer Leading Cause of Cancer Death in Under-50s
item.description: Colorectal cancer is now the leading cause of cancer death in men and women in the USA under the age of 50 combined, a new study by the American Cancer Society has revealed. The post Colorectal Cancer Leading Cause of Cancer Death in Under-50s appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: RIPK1 Inhibition Reduces Inflammation in Inflammatory Skin Diseases
item.description: These data suggested that RIPK1 inhibition targeted two central pathological processes in inflammatory skin diseases: epidermal cell death and immune-driven inflammation. The post RIPK1 Inhibition Reduces Inflammation in Inflammatory Skin Diseases appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Type 2 Diabetes Treatment Overhaul Set to Save 17,000 Lives
item.description: Prescribing patients with type 2 diabetes SGLT-2 inhibitors much earlier in the treatment process could prevent around 17,000 deaths in the UK, new NICE guidance suggests. The post Type 2 Diabetes Treatment Overhaul Set to Save 17,000 Lives appeared first on European Medical Journal.
